# Daniele Nucciarelli

> Personal portfolio and CV of Daniele Nucciarelli: physicist by training, cloud & ML engineer. Based in Perugia, Italy; works remotely.

Daniele Nucciarelli designs and runs cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm) and works on data analysis, anomaly detection and evaluation / red teaming of LLM-based agents.

Current roles:

- Founding partner, Open Innova S.r.l. (software, consulting, coaching), since 2026
- Data Scientist, Red Lynx Robotics S.r.l. (large-scale data analysis, network anomaly detection, AI agent evaluation and red teaming), since 2025
- Co-founder and Head of Infrastructure, Networking & Security, GestiSCU (multi-tenant Django SaaS), since 2024
- E-learning Platform Administrator, scuacademy, since 2023

Education: BSc in Physical Sciences and Technologies (L-30), University of Perugia.

Contact: info@daniele.nucciarelli.it

The site is a fully static Hugo site, bilingual (Italian at the root, English under /en/), with no cookies, no analytics and no external CDN requests.
